meta.title: CityTurfer — Surf your city. Own your streets.
meta.description: Walk, run or ride — every street you cover becomes your turf. Come back and watch it glow.
meta.ogAlt: CityTurfer: glowing routes on a dark city map, with the tagline Surf your city. Own your streets.

hero.lede: Walk, run or ride — every street you cover becomes your turf. Come back and watch it glow.

map.tooFar: No map near you yet, so this one stays. More cities are coming.
map.unavailable: Location isn’t available. Pick a city from the list.

hero.audience: For anyone who walks, runs or rides their city, and keeps coming back.

turfMap.title: The Turf Map
turfMap.body: Every walk, run and ride on one dark map, glowing where you go most.
turfMap.alt: The Turf Map: glowing routes across Warsaw, with 3.02 km² of turf, 1530 cells and filters for walk, run and ride.

dashboard.title: Your week at a glance
dashboard.body: Distance, time, recent activities and the next achievement within reach.
dashboard.alt: The Dashboard: this week's distance, time and activities, recent activities and the next achievement.

turf.title: Your turf
turf.summary: {cellCount, plural, one {{cells} cell} other {{cells} cells}} · {strongCount, plural, one {{strong} strong} other {{strong} strong}} · +{week} km² this week

dashboard.subtitle: {area} km² of turf · +{week} km² this week

record.title: Record a walk, run or ride
record.body: Live map, live stats and auto-pause. Hold to finish when you’re done.

gain.label: Turf gained
gain.cells: {added, plural, one {# new cell} other {# new cells}} · {reinforced} reinforced
gain.title: Every street becomes yours
gain.body: Each hexagon (about 50 m across) your track passes through is your turf, for good.

glow.legendLabel: Turf strength: Faint, Glowing, Strong, Blazing, from weakest to strongest
glow.title: Come back and watch it glow
glow.body: Every return makes a street brighter, from Faint to Blazing. Nothing fades: a street you’ve claimed stays yours, however long you’re away.

week.title: Your week, added up
week.body: This week’s distance, time and activities, your latest walks, runs and rides, and the next achievement within reach.
week.nextUp: Next up: Half marathon · Walk or run 21.1 km in one go.
week.caption: An example week, as the app shows it.

local.title: Your phone keeps the original
local.phone: Your activities are stored on your phone, in the app.
local.backup: Cloud backup stays off until you turn it on. Turn it off and the copy on our server is deleted.
local.portal: Signed in on the web, you see only what you backed up.
local.leaves: What does leave the phone: map tiles for the area you’re viewing, update checks, and, unless you turn gap filling off, the two ends of a GPS gap. Signing in sends your email address to our server.
local.account: For now, you sign in to the app with an account.
local.site: Our public pages set no cookies and load no trackers.

cta.title: Your turf starts at your door
cta.body: Leave your email and we’ll tell you when the app is ready to download.

demo.title: Come back. It glows.
demo.body: One street in Gdańsk’s Main Town, visit by visit. Then the whole city after four months of walks, runs and rides.
demo.alt: A street in Gdańsk drawn as turf cells. It is Faint after {faint, plural, one {# visit} other {# visits}}, Glowing after {glowing}, Strong after {strong} and Blazing after {blazing}. Then the whole city after four months, brightest along the routes repeated most.
demo.caption: Example data from our demo account: {activities} walks, runs and rides in Gdańsk · {area} km² · {cells, plural, one {# cell} other {# cells}}.

audience.title: Walk it. Run it. Ride it.
audience.walk: The commute, the dog, the long way home.
audience.run: The loop you know, and the turn you haven’t taken yet.
audience.cycle: Sunday rides that slowly fill in the map.
audience.notFor: Not for you if you want leaderboards, crews or training zones. CityTurfer is just you and your streets.

gain.title: New turf after every outing
gain.body: When you finish, the app shows the turf you added and the streets you made brighter.

record.title: Records with the screen off
record.body: Live map and stats, auto-pause, hold to finish. Lock the phone and keep going.

health.title: Your Apple Health history counts
health.body: Import past walks, runs and rides with their routes from Apple Health, and they become turf on day one.

achievements.title: Achievements, no streaks
achievements.body: {count, plural, one {# achievement} other {# achievements}} to unlock along the way. There’s no streak to keep.

city.title: Starts in your city
city.body: Pick your home city from the list and the map opens there.

repeats.title: Repeats count
repeats.body: Most maps mark a street once. Here every return makes it brighter.

fades.title: Nothing fades
fades.body: Your turf never decays, however long you’re away.

private.title: Private by default
private.body: No feed, no followers, no public profile.

status.title: An early prototype, honestly
status.body: What works, what we’re testing and what isn’t there yet.

works.title: Works today
works.turf: The Turf Map and turf strength

notYet.title: Not yet
notYet.android: The Android app on real phones

when.a: Join the waitlist and we’ll email you when it’s ready to download.

battery.a: It tracks your location in the background only while you record. We’re still measuring battery use on long outings.

account.a: For now, yes: you sign in with your email. Your activities still live on your phone.

data.a: Your activities are on your phone, so deleting one there deletes it. Cloud backup is off until you turn it on, and turning it off deletes our copy.

android.a: There’s an Android build, but so far it has only run on an emulator, never on a real phone. iPhone comes first.

watch.q: Do I need an Apple Watch?
watch.a: No. The app records on your phone. Importing from Apple Health is an extra on iPhone.

cities.q: Which cities does it work in?
cities.a: Recording works anywhere. Pick your home city from our list of Polish and European cities, and the map opens there.

download.note: APK for Android phones (not yet tested on real phones)
download.help: First install? Your browser asks you to allow installing apps from it — that's how apps from outside Google Play install.

waitlist.title: Join the waitlist
waitlist.consent: Email me when CityTurfer launches. I can unsubscribe at any time.
waitlist.sent: Almost there — check your inbox and confirm your email to join the waitlist.
waitlist.failed: That didn't go through. Check your connection and try again.
waitlist.privacy: {controller} stores your email with Brevo (EU) only to tell you about CityTurfer's launch. You confirm by email first. To have it deleted, write to {contactEmail}.

common.backedUpCopy: This shows the copy you backed up from your phone. Your phone is the original.
common.phoneUntouched: Signing out here doesn't touch your phone.
common.waitSeconds: Try again in {count, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
common.waitMinutes: Try again in {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
common.waitHours: Try again in {count, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.

gate.refreshFailed: Couldn't refresh just now, so this may be a little out of date.

unreachable.title: Can't reach your backup right now
unreachable.body: Your turf on the phone is fine. Check your connection, then try again.

signIn.title: Sign in to see your backup
signIn.lede: Shows the copy you backed up from your phone. Use the e-mail you signed in with in the app.
signIn.codeSent: If {email} can receive e-mail, a 6-digit code is on its way. It works for 10 minutes.
signIn.codeHint: From the e-mail we just sent. You can paste it.
signIn.codeIncomplete: Enter all 6 digits of the code.
signIn.sharedComputerHint: Signs you out when you close the browser, and after 8 hours at most.
signIn.resent: Sent again. Check your inbox and spam folder.
signIn.cookie: Signing in sets one cookie that keeps you signed in, and nothing else. No trackers.

notice.signed-out: You're signed out. Everything is still on your phone.
notice.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to carry on.
notice.deleted: Your account and its backup here are erased. Copies in our database backups are deleted after a short time. Everything is still on your phone.

register.title: Create your CityTurfer account
register.lede: All it takes is your e-mail: we send a 6-digit code, no password. Use the same e-mail in the app, and once you turn on cloud backup your activities show up here. Already have an account? The code simply signs you in.

privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.lede: What we hold for you, and how to take it with you or erase it.

backup.title: Backup
backup.never: Your turf lives on your phone. Nothing is backed up yet.
backup.withdrawn: You turned backup off on {date}, so we erased the copy here. Everything is still on your phone.
backup.healthOn: Apple Health workouts have been included since {date}.
backup.healthOff: Apple Health workouts stay on your phone. Your turf here may look smaller.
backup.changeInApp: To change these choices, open the app: Info › Cloud backup.

stored.title: What we store
stored.email: Your e-mail address, to send you sign-in codes.
stored.activities: The walks, runs and rides your phone backed up: when they happened, their stats and the route GPS recorded. Routes often start at home.
stored.city: Your city, if you chose one.
stored.consents: Your backup choices above, with the date you made each one.
stored.devices: When each device signed in and was last used. No IP addresses, device names or locations.
stored.deletions: For each activity you deleted, its id and when, so it isn't backed up again. No route.
stored.rateLimits: For about a day, a scrambled form of your e-mail and IP address, to stop people guessing sign-in codes.
stored.nothingElse: No analytics, no trackers, no advertising.

devices.title: Signed-in devices
devices.lede: Every phone and browser that is signed in to your account.
devices.signOutOthersHint: Ends the sign-in on every other browser and phone. Those phones stop backing up until you sign in again in the app; nothing on them is deleted.
devices.signOutAllHint: Ends the sign-in here, on every other browser and on your phones. Your phones stop backing up until you sign in again in the app; nothing on them is deleted.
devices.none: Only this browser is signed in.
devices.unavailable: The list of devices isn't available yet.

export.title: Get a copy
export.lede: We e-mail you a link to a zip with everything we hold: your account, your choices, and every backed-up activity as GPX. The link works for 24 hours.
export.pending: We're putting it together. The link goes to {email} in a few minutes.
export.ready: Sent. Look for the e-mail at {email}; the link works until {date}.
export.failed: That didn't work and nothing was sent. Ask again.
export.expired: That link has expired. Ask for a new copy.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.lede: Erases your account and everything backed up here: activities, routes, your city and your choices. Copies in our database backups are deleted after a short time. Your phones stop backing up until you sign in again; nothing on them is deleted.
delete.phone: Everything is still on your phone. To back up again later, turn backup on in the app.
delete.confirmHint: The button turns on once you've typed {word}.
delete.confirmMismatch: That isn't {word} yet. Upper or lower case both work.

activities.title: Activities
activities.lede: The walks, runs and rides you backed up from your phone, newest first.
activities.healthOff: Apple Health workouts stay on your phone, so they aren't listed here.

totals.title: All time
totals.meta: {count, plural, one {# activity} other {# activities}} · {duration} moving

empty.never: Your activities live on your phone. Nothing is backed up yet, so there's nothing to show here.
empty.withdrawn: You turned backup off, so we erased the copy here. All your activities are still on your phone.
empty.nothingYet: Backup is on, but nothing has arrived yet. Open the app while you have a connection, and your activities will show up here.
empty.filter: {type, select, walk {No walks in your backup yet.} run {No runs in your backup yet.} other {No rides in your backup yet.}}
empty.unknown: There is nothing in your backup to show here yet.
empty.howTo: To turn on backup, open the app: Info › Cloud backup.

detail.notFound: It isn't in your backup. It may have been deleted on your phone, or backed up from another account.
detail.estimatedNote: Includes {distance} estimated along streets where GPS was lost (dashed). Estimated parts don't claim turf.
detail.routeLabel: {gaps, select, yes {The shape of the route, without a map. Dashed lines join the recorded parts across a pause or a GPS gap.} other {The shape of the route, without a map.}}
detail.routeBetween: Between recorded parts: a pause, or a GPS gap estimated along streets
detail.routeNoMap: Just the shape, without a map: no map tiles are loaded from other sites.
detail.routeSimplified: Couldn't load the full route, so this is a simplified shape.

errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.unreachable: Can't reach your backup right now. Your turf on the phone is fine.
errors.signed-out: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.invalid-request: That doesn't look right. Check it and try again.

auth.invalid-code: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the latest e-mail, or send a new code.
auth.csrf: For your safety we only accept this from the CityTurfer website. Reload the page and try again.

consent.required: Backup is off for this account, so there's nothing here.

activity.deleted: This activity was deleted on your phone.

export.gone: That download link has expired. Ask for a new copy.
export.no-email: This account has no e-mail, so we can't send you a copy.
export.rate-limited: You can ask for one copy a day.

storage.unavailable: Your backup is resting for a moment. Your turf on the phone is fine. Try again soon.
